assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, G45.9, Z86.73.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is performed with CPT code 93229.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring requires advance approval per plan guidelines.
The claim was denied with denial code CO-197.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The necessary precertification (denial code CO-197) was appropriately waived given the documented symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and prior cerebrovascular events.
